title: Binance to Include Algo Orders in VIP Program Spot Volume Calculation
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will include users’ Time-Weighted Average Price (TWAP) and Percent of Volume (POV)  Algo Orders  trading volume as part of the VIP Program’s 30-day spot trading volume calculation from  2025-02-14 00:00 (UTC).   Additionally, users who meet the requirements for  VIP 5 and above  will enjoy  no additional fees  to trade on Algo Orders.  All users will continue to be charged the regular spot and margin trading fees as per their respective VIP levels.   Updated Algo Orders Fee Structure:  VIP   Level Additional Fee Rate Regular to VIP 4 FDUSD/USDT, USDC/USDT: 0% BTC/USDT, BTC/USDC, BTC/FDUSD, ETH/USDT, ETH/USDC, ETH/FDUSD: 0.05% All other pairs: 0.12% VIP 5 and above All listed pairs: 0% Key Highlights: Users’  Algo Orders trading volume will count toward the VIP Program’s spot volume calculation starting from  2025-02-14 00:00 (UTC) .   VIP 5 and above users  can enjoy  no additional fees  to trade on Algo Orders.  About Algo Orders: Algo Orders enhance the execution of large orders and trading on pairs with low liquidity, reducing the average cost of execution and market signaling by executing orders in smaller blocks using an intelligent execution algorithm. Find out more about Algo Order trading  here  and access the  Algo Order platform  to get started. Notes: For more information on Algo Orders, please visit the  Algo Order platform   for a full list of  FAQs .  Trading volume of all USD stablecoin trading pairs with zero trading fees, as well as any other trading pairs with zero trading fees, will be  excluded  from the final trading volume calculation. The volume generated from  Algo Orders  will  no longer  be included in users’ OTC Spot trading volume calculation. Users may visit  VIP Fee Structure  or  User Center  to confirm their current VIP level. For more information on the BNB balance requirement, please refer to the  BNB Balance Calculation rules . For more dedicated VIP and Institutional services, please refer to this   link . All trading volume and metrics related to the Program are measured by Binance at its sole and absolute discretion. Binance reserves the right to amend or terminate this Program at its sole discretion at any time. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-02-17
